publications.title: Divergent Ensemble Networks: Improving Predictive Reliability and Computational Efficiency
publications.venue: International Journal of Artificial Intelligence & Applications (IJAIA), 16(1), 21–31
publications.abstract: Introduces the Divergent Ensemble Network (DEN), a framework that combines shared representation learning with independent branching to improve predictive reliability and computational efficiency. By reducing redundant parameters while maintaining prediction diversity, DEN aims to balance predictive accuracy, uncertainty estimation, and scalability.

publications.title: Divergent Ensemble Networks: Enhancing Uncertainty Estimation with Shared Representations and Independent Branching
publications.abstract: Explores the initial framework of Divergent Ensemble Networks, utilizing shared lower-level representations alongside independent branching layers to enhance uncertainty estimation and lower computational costs compared to traditional deep ensembles.

publications.title: Deep Learning Approach for Predicting the Replicator Equation in Evolutionary Game Theory
publications.abstract: Presents a physics-informed deep learning approach for predicting the replicator equation and forecasting population dynamics in evolutionary game theory. The method uses Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems (SINDy) to identify governing equations, supporting the analysis of evolutionary dynamics across areas such as biology, economics, ecology, and social systems.
